name: Kuki Monshiro
source:
Monshiro Kuki is the youngest member of the Kuki Family. She has two siblings: the older sister [url=/c3800]Ageha Kuki[/url] and the older brother [url=/c8346]Hideo Kuki[/url]. Monshiro is one of the new female heroines to appear in Majikoi S. 

Monshiro transferred to Kawakami Academy to class 1-S, with the Kuki Family's butler, so that she is taken care of in school.

[spoiler]It is revealed in her route that she is only a half-blooded Kuki.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Monshiro_Kuki]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
